trajectory_summary: This is a thin, procedural reschedule call, not a fresh setter call — most script sections were skipped because the lead was recycled from a missed door appointment. The rep gets to a booked time but the call is structurally weak: no bill, no interest reason, no address confirmation depth, and a soft handshake at the end. Energy stayed flat throughout; nothing was built beyond logistics.
outcome_dispute: V1 tag unknown; based on transcript this is best read as tentative/booked-with-fragility — a day and time (Monday 5PM) were agreed, but the rep never confirmed 'is that fair' or addressed the 5:45 constraint against session length.
